source: hand-written spine — replaced by the course's own tree via POST /api/advisor/tree/refresh
note: Numeric questions collect the RAW number and never bucket it locally: which scenario a given tempo belongs to is the course's call, made by the notebook at the end, not a threshold invented here. Only genuinely categorical facts branch.

sessR1.q: How many sessions from the breakout to R1?
sessR1.why: The course reads the tempo of the move before anything else — the raw count goes to the notebook, which decides what that tempo means.

sessR3.q: And how many sessions from the breakout to R3? (0 if R3 has not been reached)
sessR3.why: How fast the move covers 3R is what separates a violent arrival from an ordinary trend.

reach.q: Were those levels reached intraday, or on the close?
reach.why: The course treats an intraday spike differently from a close beyond the level.

phase.q: Where is price now, relative to the R levels measured from your entry and initial stop?
phase.why: The course manages the trade differently before R1, between R1 and R2, and after R2.

options.a: Below R1 — the trade has not yet made 1R

beforeR1.exit: The initial stop stays where it is; the trade is governed by the TPG course (transformer ses pertes en gains), not by trailing.
beforeR1.quote: Avant le R1 il faut se reporter au cours de trading TPG – Transformer ses pertes en gains avec la coupe des trades.

r1r2.exit: No stop is moved. The initial stop stays at its level while the move breathes and the tempo becomes readable.
r1r2.quote: Avant le R2, le tempo peut ralentir et la trendline être cassée sans que cela ne remette en question la tendance. Il faut alors laisser respirer les cours et saisir le nouveau tempo des investisseurs. Aucun stop n'est remonté.

trendline.q: Is a trendline drawable on two structural lows, and what has price done to it?
trendline.why: After R2 the trendline becomes reliable, and its break is what authorises trailing to the first low.

options.a: Drawable, and price has broken it to the downside
Drawable, and it is still intact
Not drawable yet — only one structural low

broken.rule: Après R2 — cassure de la trendline
broken.exit: Move the stop to the first creux (low) that forms after the break. It does not need to be validated by a new high or a deep.
broken.quote: Après R2, si la trendline est cassée, le 1er creux qui se forme ensuite doit être repéré et le stop doit y être associé. Ce creux n'a pas besoin d'être validé par un plus haut (dow) ou par un deep pour que le stop soit remonté.

dow.q: Has a new Dow structure formed — a new high followed by a higher low?
dow.why: With the trendline intact, the stop follows validated structure rather than every low.

options.a: Yes, a new validated higher low exists
No new structure since the last one

trailDow.rule: Trailing sur la structure de Dow
trailDow.exit: Trail the stop under the newest validated higher low.

hold.exit: Leave the stop where it is until a new validated low or a trendline break appears.
hold.quote: (the course's rule that the stop only moves on a validated structure)
